description: This PHP source file defines the InterviewerUserRole class, which extends AbstractUserRole and manages access control for interview-related entities within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It provides methods to retrieve accessible IDs for various entities such as vacancies, candidates, interviews, attachments, and candidate history, specifically tailored for an interviewer role.

classes.name: InterviewerUserRole
classes.description: Represents the user role for interviewers, providing access to entities relevant to their responsibilities such as candidates and interviews, based on permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Returns IDs of entities accessible to the interviewer based on entity type and permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateIds
methods.description: Retrieves candidate IDs the interviewer has access to.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewIds
methods.description: Retrieves interview IDs the interviewer has access to.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewAttachmentIds
methods.description: Retrieves interview attachment IDs accessible to the interviewer.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateHistoryIds
methods.description: Retrieves candidate history IDs accessible to the interviewer.

methods.name: getAccessibleVacancyIds
methods.description: Retrieves vacancy IDs accessible to the interviewer.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateActionHistoryIds
methods.description: Retrieves candidate action history IDs accessible to the interviewer.
